title: BLE local transport: nRF52840 vs ESP32-S3
description: Cross-validate BLE local transport between nRF52840 (working) and ESP32-S3 (needs validation). Test connection, framing, and throughput.
notes: Hardware validation required: ESP32-S3 BLE local transport requires physical hardware. Code is platform-agnostic (ble_ingress.c uses Zephyr APIs), but ESP32-S3 BLE config is intentionally disabled. Validation needs: (1) create BLE-enabled board conf for T-Deck/ESP32-S3 with CONFIG_BT=y and CONFIG_LICHEN_HAS_BLE_LOCAL=y, (2) physical device testing for connection/framing/throughput cross-validation vs nRF52840.
